data.name: Limited Alchemy
data.description: A gravedigger prepares and uses extracts as an investigator but gains no other benefits of the alchemy ability. This also means that a gravedigger can't take the alchemist discovery investigator talent or any discovery that affects or involves alchemy. This alters alchemy and investigator talents.
